messages.subject: Re: Rattle Users Discussion List update
messages.body_plain:
Thank you for your patience whilst the list was out of action because
it was tagged with Spam. It seems to be functioning again.

So it might be timely for an update.....

Work on Rattle has been progressing, with assistance also from
Information Builders, who have now released Rattle as RStat for users
of their WebFocus business intelligence product. They have also been
providing QA to iron out bugs, so Rattle is more stable than ever.

Some key improvements include:

* cleaner GUI
* addition of the Test and Transform tabs
* experimental support for automatic report generation
* addition of latticist (interactive data plotting)
* improved support for exporting PMML

To get the latest beta version:

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com")

(See http://code.google.com/p/rattle/)

Regards,
Graham
